newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa and coffee pare gains, sugar still up.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa and coffee pare gains, sugar still up.

text.p: COCOA - Still finishes up but well below new peak despite volatile NY. Sept ends 10 up at 1,160 stg after a 1,170 peak.
COFFEE - Also pares gains after NY comes off from early highs on reduced frost risk in Brazil. Sept still $25 up at $1,822.
SUGAR - Off highs despite firm New York. Aug up $1.20 at $322.40 at 1703 GMT.
